summary: Round 1 of the new module (DEC-120 item: 'Déf. 12 is to be certified by building the étalé topology on the jet space J(V) and proving J(V) → V a covering map'). The étalé topology is the standard one: generated by {jet y f | y ∈ W}, W open, f : M → X arbitrary. isOpen_iff_isEtaleOpen proves Basic's IsEtaleOpen to be exactly openness in it, for ANY set of jets. isCoveringMap_jets is a genuine covering map in Mathlib's sense: IsCoveringMap.mk with real Bundle.Trivializations over every chart domain, fibre G with the discrete topology, all four continuity fields proved. The hypothesis set is honest: a (G,X)-structure, ContinuousConstSMul (needed to define gxGroupoid), IsAnalyticAction (rigidity, which makes the sheets disjoint); the discrete topology on G is introduced inside the proof and does not appear in the statement; nothing is assumed of M. With Basic's IsJetStructure (1°, 2°, iso jets) this covers all of Déf. 12, and the mark is earned. The scoped étalé instance works where it is used and downstream with `open scoped Benzecri`; no diamond exists. Five nits. Ready to graduate together with Structure/Basic.

checks.etale_topology: etaleBasis M X = {(fun y => jet y f) '' W | f : M → X, W open}; etaleTopology = generateFrom of it. This is the étalé space of the sheaf of germs of all maps M → X, the topology J(V) carries in the paper (and the one Prop. 2's proof uses). continuous_jet: y ↦ jet y g is continuous for every g (preimage of a basic set is {y ∈ W | f =ᶠ g}, open by Eventually.eventually_nhds). continuous_jetSource: the source projection is continuous. isOpen_etaleBasic, exists_jet_eq, jet_mem_image_jet_iff: correct helpers
checks.isOpen_iff_isEtaleOpen: For every J : Set (Jet M X): (⇒) continuity of y ↦ jet y f at x; (⇐) around jet x f, the basic set jet '' W with W ⊆ {y | jet y f ∈ J} from IsEtaleOpen. So Basic's IsEtaleOpen is exactly « ensemble ouvert » in the étalé topology, and IsJetStructure.isOpen holds. Correct; no hypothesis beyond the (unused) X-topology binder (nit 1)
checks.isCoveringMap_jets_genuine: Mathlib's IsCoveringMap f := ∀ x, IsEvenlyCovered f x (f ⁻¹' {x}) (Topology/Covering/Basic.lean:287), IsEvenlyCovered asking DiscreteTopology of the fibre and a homeomorphism f⁻¹U ≃ₜ U × I over an open U ∋ x. The proof uses IsCoveringMap.mk (l.328) with F x = G (⊥ topology, DiscreteTopology by rfl) and t x = jetsTrivialization (chart_mem_maximalAtlas x), x ∈ baseSet by mem_chart_source. jetsTrivialization he is a full Bundle.Trivialization over e.source for ANY chart e of the maximal atlas: toFun j = (source, sheetIndex), invFun (y, g) = g • jet y e (junk off e.source, irrelevant), left/right inverse from mem_jets_iff_existsUnique (the unique sheet, IsAnalyticAction), open source (continuity of the projection), continuousOn_toFun (sheetIndex is locally constant: the basic open {jet y (g₀ • e) | y ∈ e.source} is a neighbourhood on which it is g₀), continuousOn_invFun (on e.source × {g₀} it is y ↦ jet y (g₀ • e), continuous). Nothing is defined away. Non-vacuity: instantiated in scratch at the model spaces (ℝⁿ over itself for GAR n, S n over itself for GSR n), and isCoveringMap_jets_aff.isLocalHomeomorph elaborates
checks.hypotheses: isCoveringMap_jets: [ChartedSpace X M] [HasGroupoid M (gxGroupoid G X)] [ContinuousConstSMul G X] [IsAnalyticAction G X], M any topological space (generalises « variété connexe », as the checklist says), G any group. IsAnalyticAction = FaithfulSMul + IsRigidAction: rigidity makes the sheets over a chart pairwise disjoint (without it J(V) can be non-Hausdorff and is not a covering), faithfulness makes the fibre G rather than a quotient; both are instances for (GSR n, S n) (wave 1) and (GAR n, ℝⁿ) (Basic), so isCoveringMap_jets_proj / _aff carry NO hypothesis beyond the structure. The `letI : TopologicalSpace G := ⊥` is inside the proof; the statement does not mention a topology on G, so a group with its own topology (e.g. GSR n as a quotient of GL) is not constrained. Honest
checks.def12_coverage: Déf. 12 asserts: (a) J(V) an OPEN set of jets of isomorphisms — IsJetStructure.iso + isEtaleOpen, with isOpen_iff_isEtaleOpen / IsJetStructure.isOpen; (b) 1° — source_surjective; (c) 2° — smul_mem + transitive; (d) J(V) defines the structure — exists_hasGroupoid_jets_eq_iff, maximalAtlas_eq_of_jets_eq (Basic); (e) « J(V), muni de la projection source sur V est un revêtement de V » — isCoveringMap_jets for the J(V) of a structure and IsJetStructure.isCoveringMap for EVERY J satisfying (a)-(c).
